name: Paxton
source:
"Hmm... I like to think I'm pretty decent at writing weekly campaigns, but my REAL skills are in latte art."

Major: Creative Writing
Skills: Strength, latte art, running TTRPGs

50% Nerd, 50% Jock

Paxton is friendly, easy to get along with, and is SO down for you dropping to join his latest campaign. He likes various latte concoctions. He would never describe himself as a people person though... Why could that be?

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/enamored-risks]itch.io[/url]]
